triples.subject: Alyosha
triples.quote: Alyosha gave his evidence modestly and with restraint, but his warm sympathy for his unhappy brother was unmistakable.

triples.subject: Dmitri
triples.quote: I was led to do so by my brother Dmitri’s words.

triples.subject: Dmitri
triples.quote: through his passion for Grushenka and his rivalry with his father, his brother had been of late in an intolerable position.

triples.subject: Katerina Ivanovna
triples.quote: Katerina Ivanovna replied firmly that she had been formerly betrothed to the prisoner, “until he left me of his own accord...”

triples.subject: Dmitri
triples.quote: when he had the means of repaying Katerina Ivanovna half (half, note!) what he owed her, he yet could not bring himself to repay the money

triples.subject: Dmitri
triples.quote: My idea seemed silly to me at the time, but he was perhaps pointing then to that little bag in which he had fifteen hundred roubles!

triples.subject: Fyodor Pavlovitch
triples.quote: He felt quite certain that he would receive the money from his father, and spoke to me several times about it.

triples.subject: Dmitri Fyodorovitch Karamazov
triples.quote: I knew he had a feud with his father and have always believed that he had been unfairly treated by his father.

triples.subject: Katerina Ivanovna
triples.quote: I was once indebted to him for assistance in money for more than three thousand, and I took it, although I could not at that time foresee that I should ever be in a position to repay my debt.

triples.subject: Samsonov
triples.quote: He was my benefactor; he took me when I hadn’t a shoe to my foot, when my family had turned me out.

triples.subject: Smerdyakov
triples.quote: The lackey, Smerdyakov, who murdered his master and hanged himself last night.

triples.subject: Rakitin
triples.quote: Why, he is my cousin. His mother was my mother’s sister. But he’s always besought me not to tell any one here of it, he is so dreadfully ashamed of me.

triples.subject: Fyodor Pavlovitch
triples.quote: had only heard from “that wicked wretch” that Fyodor Pavlovitch had an envelope with notes for three thousand in it.

triples.subject: Arrest at Mokroe
triples.quote: “When the prisoner was arrested at Mokroe,” the prosecutor asked, “every one saw and heard you run out of the next room

triples.subject: Dmitri Fyodorovitch Karamazov
triples.quote: “When the prisoner was arrested at Mokroe,” the prosecutor asked, “every one saw and heard you run out of the next room

triples.subject: Grushenka
triples.quote: “When the prisoner was arrested at Mokroe,” the prosecutor asked, “every one saw and heard you run out of the next room and cry out: ‘It’s all my fault.
